newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico opens bidding for Toluca gas distribution.
newsitem.headline: Mexico opens bidding for Toluca gas distribution.

text.p: Mexico will begin accepting bids on Feb. 14 for natural gas distribution in the industrial city of Toluca, the Energy Regulatory Commission said in a statement Monday.
The bidder with the lowest gas tariff to gas consumers, while fulfilling service requirements, will win a 30-year concession to deliver natural gas in the region, the commission said.
Bids are due April 14, and the winner will be announced July 9, the commission said.
Located 66 kilometers from Mexico City, Toluca accounts for 18 percent of gross domestic product in the state of Mexico and two percent of the national GDP.
The winning concession will use natural gas provided by Mexico's state oil and gas monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex).
